details.s: Maeglin was an Elf, the son of Eöl the "Dark Elf" and Aredhel, daughter of Fingolfin. He lived during the First Age of the Sun in Middle-earth, and was a lord of the hidden Elven kingdom of Gondolin. He became infamous for his betrayal of the location of Gondolin to the Dark Lord Morgoth.
f: Avari (Moriquendi), Ñoldor (House of Fingolfin), Gondolindrim (House of the Mole)
